summary: Full backend + frontend regression for SIK-PPBJ. 24/24 pytest cases pass covering superadmin+demo logins, /auth/me, RBAC (user 403, superadmin 200), Documents CRUD for PPBJ/PUM/PP/PTUM, doc number format NNN/PPBJ-BJM/MM/YYYY, approval chain (approved & rejected), generate-journal gating (400 if not approved), balanced journal for PP with PPN 11% + PPh23 (dpp=1M -> ppn=110k, pph=20k, debit=kredit=1.110.000), journals list, dashboard summary (>=6 seeded docs, total_nilai>=123.8M), budget-units returns 4 seeded units, /api/budgets?period=2026-09 returns total_pagu=435.000.000 with total_realisasi filled, budget POST/DELETE by keuangan, tax-settings defaults (PPN 11%, PPH23), accounts list ~29 + CRUD. Frontend: superadmin login redirects to /, all 10 pages (/documents/{PPBJ,PUM,PP,PTUM}, /jurnal, /anggaran, /accounts, /tax-settings, /users, /activity-log) load without any console/page errors; /anggaran renders all 4 seeded units with Rp 435.000.000 total pagu & Rp 123.800.000 realisasi.

ui_bugs.issue: Card uses className `bg-[#0d3c45] border-0` with `text-white` value, but the dark teal background is not being applied at runtime (arbitrary-value tailwind class not compiled/safelisted). Result: white text on white card => value Rp 123.800.000 is invisible, and label uses `text-teal-200` which is very low contrast on white. Verified via screenshot.

action_items: Fix Dashboard 'Total Nilai Pengajuan' card: replace `bg-[#0d3c45]` with a Tailwind class that is actually compiled (e.g. `bg-teal-900` / add color to tailwind.config safelist) so the dark background and readable white value appear. Also bump label from `text-teal-200` to something readable if bg fix is not applied.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py generate-journal correctly gates on status=='approved' (400 otherwise) and marks doc posted + journal_generated true. Balanced check ok.
compute_pph handles flat/progressive/tiered; PP with ppn_enabled + PPH23_JASA produced perfectly balanced ledger (debit=kredit=1.110.000) — good.
next_doc_number uses count+1 which is non-atomic; concurrent creations could collide on the sequence but format is correct for single-user flows.
PUT /api/budgets/{bid} still does not 404 on missing id (carried over from iteration 4).
require_roles bypasses check for superadmin — matches spec.
seed_demo idempotency uses app_meta marker; safe.
Dashboard.jsx: uses tailwind arbitrary class `bg-[#0d3c45]` which is not being applied in the deployed build (visible as bug above). Prefer palette color or add to safelist.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Server date resolves to 2026-09 (seed_demo period). PP journal math: dpp * (1 + ppn_rate/100) - pph. RBAC: user role blocked from /api/users, /api/documents/*/generate-journal. Login endpoint redirects to '/' (not '/dashboard') on success — do not wait_for_url '**/dashboard**'. Frontend visible bug: Dashboard 'Total Nilai Pengajuan' card missing background.
rca of the issue: Dashboard 'Total Nilai Pengajuan' invisible value RCA: className `bg-[#0d3c45] border-0` uses Tailwind arbitrary hex value; JIT/CRACO build in this project does not seem to compile it (or purge removed it), so the card falls back to inherited white background. Since the value uses `text-white`, it becomes invisible. Fix: replace with a compiled palette color like `bg-slate-800` or `bg-teal-900`, or add `#0d3c45` to tailwind.config safelist / theme.extend.colors.
